name: Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare
description: Like the Glamoth armor corroded by "Propagation," beneath that shell covered in a strange matter lies only wishes distorted by the Stellaron. Deep within the dreamscape, the Swarm Disaster resurfaces in this form.

skills.name: Malignform Elytra
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rapacious Appendages
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: Encroach, Mangle, Sate
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rend, Putrefy, Engorge
skills.description: Enter the "Gene Duplication" state, increasing this unit's SPD and summoning "Juvenile Sting."

skills.name: Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Primal Hunger
skills.description: Increases the SPD of "Juvenile Sting" summoned by this unit.

skills.name: Universal Blight, Howl of the Life Eater
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, whenever this unit uses an attack, additionally deals minor Fire DMG based on the number of "Juvenile Sting" remaining. After any "Juvenile Sting" uses an attack, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" gains a stack of "Mortal Instinct." When "Mortal Instinct" reaches a certain number of stacks, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" will immediately take action, use "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death," and clear all "Mortal Instinct" stacks.

skills.name: Umbral Engulfment
skills.description: After using "Rend, Putrefy, Engorge," this unit gains the "Umbral Engulfment" state, its Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG taken is greatly reduced. "Juvenile Sting" gains "Nightmare Protection," its Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG taken is greatly reduced. The efficiency of Fire DMG in dispelling "Nightmare Protection" greatly increases. If this unit's HP drops to a certain threshold before using "Rend, Putrefy, Engorge," it immediately uses "Rend, Putrefy, Engorge."

skills.name: Symbiosis, Swarm, Gnaw
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, the field enters Combustion. When the "Nightmare Protection" of the summoned "Juvenile Sting" is dispelled, this unit's "Gene Duplication" and "Umbral Engulfment" are dispelled, and the DMG this unit takes increases.
